rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the Court on a narrow, legitimacy-protecting path: reject categorical presidential criminal immunity while emphasizing tailored, doctrine-based protections (privilege, statutory construction, mens rea) rather than a constitutional safe harbor. The three dissenters are likely to fracture into at least one principal dissent (Alito or Thomas) with Kavanaugh either joining or writing separately to press a remand/"official act sorting" framework.
